description: Use this when the user pastes a cloud drive share link (Google Drive, Baidu Netdisk 百度网盘) or a social post link (YouTube, X or Twitter, Reddit, TikTok, Pinterest, Instagram, Threads, Facebook, LinkedIn, Telegram, Bilibili) and wants the files, a direct download or the canonical link. Pass `url`, or the whole share message; `password` is the Baidu extraction code (提取码) when sent apart from the link. A drive link returns its files with name, size and date, and Google Drive a direct_url with ready curl, aria2c and Aria2 or Motrix hand-off. A social link returns canonical_url: the platform's own form of the link, tracking parameters dropped, short links followed once. Public links only; private files are refused. Nothing stored.

password.description: The share's extraction code (Baidu 提取码), when the owner sent one apart from the link. A pwd= in the link is read on its own.

url.description: The share link as the owner sent it, such as https://drive.google.com/file/d/<id>/view or https://pan.baidu.com/s/1<code>?pwd=abcd.

name: resolve_share_link

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

canonical_url.description: The link in the provider's own canonical form, read from a social share link or a short link's redirect. Null for a drive share, which resolves to files instead.

download.description: direct: direct_url works with curl. sign_in_required: the drive lists the files but serves bytes only to a signed-in account.

direct_url.description: A URL that downloads the bytes with no sign-in, or null when the drive needs a signed-in account.

aria2_rpc.description: The aria2 JSON-RPC body to POST to a running aria2 (default http://localhost:6800/jsonrpc) or to Motrix (http://localhost:16800/jsonrpc).

aria2c.description: An aria2c command line with 4 connections.

curl.description: A curl command that saves the file under its own name.

handoff.description: Ready commands for curl, aria2c and Aria2 or Motrix RPC, when direct_url is set.

modified.description: ISO 8601 time the drive reports, when it reports one.

open_url.description: Where the file or folder opens at the drive.

path.description: The path inside the share, for drives that show one.

message.description: One plain sentence on what was found or what to do next.

provider.description: The registry id of the drive, such as google_drive or baidu.

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

truncated.description: True when the share holds more entries than the answer lists.

title: Resolve a share link
